 WASHINGTON, D.C. — U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly will host a telephone town hall Wednesday to answer questions about Medicare Open Enrollment.
 Kelly will be joined by officials from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services and Pennsylvania Medicare Education & Decision Insight.
 The town hall begins at 6 p.m. Nov. 18. Residents of Pennsylvania’s 16th Congressional District can participate by calling 855-531-1063.
 A livestream will also be available on Kelly’s Facebook page .
 Medicare Open Enrollment runs through Dec. 7.
